## Goal / acceptance criteria
Update `docs/user/INSTALL.md` and `docs/user/troubleshooting.md` for 0.3.1: the first start can take up to a minute; a small 'Free My ID is starting' window stays until the app is ready; after two minutes it says it is still starting and there is no need to click again; updating with the new installer keeps your details and the scheduled check; the app may need reopening after an update. Plain words for a 72-year-old reader. Cite the source of each fact in an HTML comment (file:line in `packaging/windows/` or `src/freemyid/wizard/desktop.py`).

Fake data only (Jane Q Testperson, Springfield IL). Tests must pass on Windows too: `tmp_path` and `pathlib`, no hard-coded `/tmp` or POSIX-only paths. A real product bug = strict `xfail` with the reason plus a file:line finding in VENDOR_STATUS.md; never edit `src/`. Check existing tests first (`tests/`, `tests/copilot/`, `tests/codex/`, `tests/grok/`) and don't duplicate a guard.
